facts.text: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy hit the saloon in Carson City.
facts.why: The barroom brawl where Chon and Roy meet is in a small town tavern on the way. Wikipedia puts Roy's hideout (a bordello) in Carson City, and no saloon scene there is described. Same text is printed on the card.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Chon and Roy start the barroom brawl.

facts.text: I came to rescue a princess, Roy. Now pass the noodles before you eat them all.
facts.why: Not a Chon line, and the card prints it in quote marks. The Wikiquote page has nothing like it. It reads fine as a note in his voice.
facts.fix: Roy, I came here to rescue a princess. Pass the noodles before you eat them all.

fix_note.text: Roy, I came here to rescue a princess. Pass the noodles before you eat them all.

facts.text: Roy's drinking game, bathtub not included.
facts.why: No opened source shows a drinking game or a bathtub for Roy.

vibe.verdict: The wanted-poster saloon looks right, but the menu skips the film's best bits like the chopsticks, the buried Roy and Falling Leaves.
